directions.text: Study the information below and answer the given questions :
directions.passage: A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H are sitting in a circle not necessarily in the same order. Four of them are facing outside and four of them are facing the centre. E faces outside, both the immediate neighbours of E face the centre. H sits second to the right of E, B sits third to the left of E. D faces the centre. Both the immediate neighbours of D faces outsides. G sits second to the left of A. B sits third to the right of H. F is an immediate neighbour of D. C is an immediate neighbour of G. D is not an immediate neighbour of B.

directions.text: Question number 43 and 44 based on the information given below :
directions.passage:
(i) A, B, C, D and E are five men sitting in a line facing to south-while M, N, O, P and Q are five ladies sitting in a second line parallel to the first line and are facing to North.
(ii) B who is just next to the left of D, is opposite to Q.
(iii) C and N are diagonally opposite to each other.
(iv) E is opposite to-O who is just next right of M.
(v) P who is just to the left of Q, is opposite to D.
(vi) M is at one end of the line.

directions.text: Study the following information carefully and answer the question given below.
directions.passage: A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. H is fourth to the left of B and second to the right of F. A is third to the left of C, who is not an immediate neighbour of F. G is second to the left of A. D is second to the right of E.

questions.stem: Sonu is taller than Yatendra. Subhash is taller than Amit. Sattu is the tallest. Amit is taller than Sonu. If they stand according to their height then who will be exactly in the middle?

The areas of seven circles C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, C6 and C7 are compared. The area of C? is greater than C? and less than C?. The area of C4 is greater than C? and less than C?. The area of C? is more than C?. If the area of C? is the lowest, then which of the following options is correct?

A is greater than B in height. C and D are same in height. E is shorter than B but taller than D in height. F is shorter in height than C, who is shorter than B. Who is the smallest in height among all of them?
Among five friends, Vivek is older than Akram. Sumit is older than Dara. Manjeet is younger than Dara. There are two persons older than Sumit. Who is the eldest among these friends?

The height of Rama is greater than that of Saaho. The height of Manoj is less than that of Dinesh. Dinesh's height is more than Tara but less than Saaho. The height of Kailash is less than that of Tara but greater than that of Manoj. Tara's height is less than Saho's. Whose height is the least?

P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are seven friends having different ages. R is elder than 4 persons. Q is elder than R but younger than P. T. is elder than U but younger than S. U is not the youngest. Who is the youngest among all ?

A, B, C, D, E, F and G are seven friends having different heights. A is taller than C but shorter than B. C is taller than F but shorter than A. B is taller than A but shorter than 2 persons. D is taller than B. E is not the tallest and G is the shortest. How many people are taller than C ?

P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are seven friends having different heights. R is taller than 4 persons. Q is taller than R but shorter than P. T is taller than U but shorter than S. U is not the shortest. How many people are shorter than T ?
Mohini is taller than Neeta, but not shorter than Sarita. Sarita and Malini are of equal height. Mohini is younger than Hema. Who is the second tallest among them?

Seven boys M, K, C, P, S, T and U participate in a contest. All of them finish on different ranks from 1 to 7. 1 being the highest and 7 being the lowest. The rank of S is lower than K, but higher than C. The rank of T is one below U and one above P. U has the second highest rank. The rank of S is less than only four boys. C has the least rank. Whose rank is the third from the last ?

Six people, F, G, H, I, J and K, got different marks in their examination. G got more marks than F and K. F got more marks than I, but not the highest marks. G scored more marks than H. K got more marks than J, but fewer marks than H. I got the third lowest marks. F got more marks than K but less than H. F got 59 marks and K got 46 marks. Who among the following got the highest marks ?
The first semester scores of six students show that Raman has scored more marks than Ritesh, but he is second only to Harshita. If Ankur has the lowest marks, then what is the position of Raghav?

Five children appeared in an aptitude test in a class.
In the result report, it is found that boy A got less marks than boy B. Boy C got less marks than boy D, boy B got less marks than boy C and boy A got more marks than boy E. Which child got the second highest marks?

Five students A, B, C, D and E of class XII are appearing for their annual examination. Student A finished his exam before student B but after C. D finished his exam before E but after B. Who among the five students finished his examination first?

There are five cousins namely Ashish, Manish, Kailash, Daksh and Lalit of different ages. All these cousins are arranged in the descending order of their ages. Ashish, brother of Kailash is the second youngest and is 19 years old. Daksh, brother of Lalit, is between Kailash and Manish. Kailash is 42 years old and Ashish is 20 years younger than Daksh. Who among the following is the youngest?

Among seven friends, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, G is older than A and C. C is older than D. F is older than only one friend. A is the third oldest. E is the youngest. G is younger than B. who is the tallest ?
A is older than B while C and D are older than E who is between A and C. If C is elder than B, then who is the youngest?

Seven athletes A, B, C, D, E, F and G participate in a race. E is ahead of A but behind F. D is ahead of only two athlete. G is running last. C is running behind only two athlete. F is not the first.
Which athlete is running in the fourth position from behind ?

Five friends A, B, C, D and E bought cars which were priced differently. B's car was costlier than C's car but was less costly than E's car. A's car was costlier than D's car but less costly than C's car. Whose car was the 2nd costliest ?

Five friends' houses are located in an straight line. Amit's house is not near Dipesh's house. Shayana's house is between Brinda's and Sheetal's house. Brinda's house is between Shayana and Dipesh. Whose houses are located near Sheetal?

6 phones P1, P2, P3, P4, P5 and P6 are placed in a row facing north. (The order is not necessary.) P1, is placed on the immediate left of P6. P5 is second to the left of P2. P4 is second to the right of P6. P4 is to the immediate right of P5. P3 is to the left of P1. How many phones are there between P3 and P6 ?

Six towels are placed one above the other. The red coloured towel is just above the white coloured towel. The yellow coloured towel is between the blue and green coloured towels. The pink coloured towel is between the red coloured towel and the blue coloured towel. Which colour towel is between the pink and the yellow towel?

Six soldiers A, B, C, D, E and F are standing one after the other in a row. F sits next to the left of C. F and E are at the ends of the line. C is exactly between F and B. A is immediate next to the left of D. E sits next to the right of D. Which soldier is fourth from the right?

Five animals are in their cages in a zoo. Their cages are in a row. The monkey is at the last position on one side of the line. Cow is next to the immediate left of deer. The lion is at the last position on the right side of the row. The fox is right in between the deer and the lion. Which animal is second from the left?
There are five houses A, B, C, D, O in a row. A is to the right of B and to the left of C. O is to the right of A, B is to the right of D. Tell which house is in the middle.

Ramesh is richer than Satish, but Jaya is less rich than Ramesh. Ram is less rich than Jaya but richer than Satish but is not as rich as Ramesh. Ramesh is less rich than Navin. The richest amongst than is?

Six friends Asha, Barsha, Selia, Disha, Emili and Ferheen are sitting in a row facing north direction. Selia is middle between Asha and Emili. Disha is not at the end. Barsha is exactly right of Emili Ferheen is not at the right end.
How many persons right of Disha ?

D. C, B and A are sitting around a table facing each other, them different colours Likes Yellow, Blue, Black, Red.
(a) D sits opposite to the one who likes black colour.
(b) C sits immediate right of the one who likes Blue colour.
(c) The one who likes yellow colour is to the left of the one who likes red colour.
(d) A sits opposite to B who does not like yellow colour.
Who likes red ?

Six persons are standing together in two rows of each three, facing each other. Mohan is not standing at Row's end but Junaid is on the right side who is standing facing Chaman. Kartik is left side of Das Who is standing facing Mohan. Who is to the left of Barun?

Amit, Vinod, Chandu and Dixit are sitting on four consecutive seats in a theatre. But Chandu and Dixit are not sitting together and Vinod is not sitting in the third place. If Amit and Vinod are sitting together, then which of the following must be necessarily true?

options.A: Dixit is at the first place
options.B: Dixit is not at the first place
options.C: Amit is at the third place
options.D: Chandu is at the first place

questions.stem: Sachin, Sahil, Sandhya, Sani, Sanju, Saurahb, Shweta and Sunil are sitting around a round table in the same for such at equal distance. Their positions are Anti-clockwise. If Sandhya sits facing North, then in which direction Sanju is facing.

Sachin, Sahil, Sandhya, Sani, Sanju, Saurabh, Shweta and Sunil are sitting around a round table in the same order for lunch at equal distance. Their positions are Anti-clockwise. If Sandhya sits facing South then in which direction Sunil is facing
Eight persons P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting around a circular table at equal distance from each other facing the centre. If P is facing North-east then which direction is S facing?

Sachin, Sahil, Sandhya, Sani, Sajnu, Saurabh, Shweta and Sunil are sitting around a round table in the same order for lunch at equal distance. Their positions are Anti-clockwise. If Sandhya, sits facing East, then in which direction Sahil is facing?

Children A, B, C, D, E, F and G are standing in a line. F is to the left of A and right of B, D is between G and B, E is standing left of C and G is right of C. Who is standing at the fourth right of C?

Sachin, Sahil, Sandhya, Sani, Sanju, Saurabh, Shweta and Sunil are sitting around a round table in the same order of lunch at equal distance. Their positions are Anti-clockwise. If Sandhya sits facing East, then in which direction Saurabh is facing?

S, T, U, V, X, Y and Z are sitting around a round table for group discussion. T is sitting third to the right of S and between U and Z. Z is sitting third to the right of Y, V is sitting right of X. What will be the position of T?

options.A: is sitting between Y and X
options.B: T is sitting third to the left of X
options.C: T is sitting third to the left of V
options.D: T is sitting Second to the left of U

questions.stem: Six people are sitting in a garden with 3 of them facing the other 3. A is sitting to the north of B whereas B is to the immediate west of C. E sits across F who sits to the east of C. In what direction does D sit with respect to C ?

Four Men A, B, C and D and four women W, X, Y and Z are sitting round a table facing each other. No two men or women are sitting together. W is to the right of B. Y is facing X and is to the left of A. C is to the right of Z. Who are the two persons sitting adjacent to D?
How many are seated between A and C (counting clockwise from A) ?
Who sits exactly between F and C ?
Who sits third to the right of A ?
Who is sitting third to the right of O?
Which of the following pair is diagonally opposite to each other?
Who is on the immediate right of F?
Who is third to the left of A?
In which of the following pairs is the first person sitting on the immediate left of the second person?
Which of the following pairs represents the immediate neighbour of E?
Who is on the immediate right of H?

Freya is on the left of the person sitting in middle but is on the right of Bella. Sara is on the right of Jamie and Austin is on the right of Sara. Austin is the second person from the person sitting in the middle. Who is sitting in the middle ?
Five boys A, B, C, D and E are sitting in a row. A is to the right of B and E is to the left of B but to the right of C. A is to the left of D. Who is second from the left end ?
